# Leeds, Grenville and Lanark District Health Unit

> Public health authority serving Eastern Ontario communities with clinical services, immunization programs, health equity initiatives, and community wellness support.

The Leeds, Grenville and Lanark District Health Unit is a regional public health organization providing vaccination clinics, prenatal education, harm reduction services, and health surveillance across multiple Eastern Ontario communities including Brockville, Smiths Falls, Kemptville, and Lanark. The organization is committed to health equity and operates as a Best Practice Spotlight Organization for LGBTQ health initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Immunization services
- Prenatal education
- Infant feeding support
- Harm reduction programs
- Food handler training
- Oral health clinic
- Health equity
- Board of Health governance
- Public health surveillance
- Community clinics
- Vaccine administration
- LGBTQ health equity
- Eastern Ontario public health
- Appointment booking
- Health statistics and reporting

## Clinical Services & Programs

- [Clinics & Classes](https://healthunit.org/clinics-classes): Overview of clinics and classes including vaccination, prenatal and sexual health
- [Immunization Clinic](https://healthunit.org/clinics-classes/immunization-clinic): Immunization clinic locations, vaccine services and appointment booking
- [Influenza Clinic](https://healthunit.org/clinics-classes/influenza-clinic): Seasonal influenza vaccination clinic offering free flu shots to Ontario residents
- [Infant Feeding Clinic](https://healthunit.org/clinics-classes/infant-feeding-clinic): Infant feeding and breastfeeding support clinic with registered nurse guidance
- [Prenatal Education](https://healthunit.org/clinics-classes/prenatal-education): Prenatal education classes including Bump to Baby and INJOY online courses
- [Baby Talk](https://healthunit.org/clinics-classes/baby-talk): Baby Talk parent support group and infant development drop-in clinic program
- [Oral Health Clinic](https://healthunit.org/clinics-classes/oral-health-clinic): Pediatric dental services and preventive dentistry for children and teens
- [Needle Syringe Program & Naloxone](https://healthunit.org/clinics-classes/needle-syringe-program-naloxone): Harm reduction programs including needle syringe service and naloxone training
- [Rabies Vaccination Clinics](https://healthunit.org/clinics-classes/rabies-clinic): Low-cost rabies vaccination clinics for dogs and cats in Leeds, Grenville and Lanark
- [Food Handler Training Course](https://healthunit.org/clinics-classes/food-handler-training-course): Food handler certification training course, in-person and online options available
